# gitea_pull_request_by_base_head (Data Source)

Fetches a pull request by base and head branch names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_pull_request_by_base_head" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
  base_ref         = "main"
  head_ref         = "feature-branch"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_ref` (String) The base branch name.
- `head_ref` (String) The head branch name.
- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pull_request` (List of Object) The matching pull request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pull_request))
